scope: Theorem A.1 (Rational rank-one signing) of the manuscript “A polynomial-time construction of strong thin trees” (preprints/A-polynomial-time-construction-of-strong-thin-trees-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 174 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 da0e75ba53ff393f), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 30. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Given rational Hermitian matrices H1, . . . , HN of rank at most one, a deterministic algorithm returns signs σi ∈ {−1, 1} such that X i σiHi ≤ 40 X i H2 i 1/2 . Its running time is polynomial in the total binary encoding length. Consequently, for rational columns vi with P i viv∗ i = I, the same algorithm gives discrepancy at most 40 p maxi ∥vi∥2.
